next.reason: 1985: "REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY ... ] [ NOT INVALID KEY ... ]"; 2023: "REWRITE {record-name-1 | FILE file-name-1} [FROM {identifier-1|literal-1}] [retry-phrase] [WITH LOCK|WITH NO LOCK] |INVALID KEY| |NOT INVALID KEY|". 2023 adds FILE file-name-1, FROM literal-1, retry and LOCK phrases. Its choice indicators let INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY appear in either order, so more programs are accepted.
